validation_rules: Daily counts use fixed daily entries/results; the 11,395 reference uses earlier revisions and is a separate cohort.
Match identical race ID, date, venue, race number, field size and normalized rider names paired with car numbers.
The men's flag, rider IDs and complete line groups are from later daily data; line publication before the race is not verified.
For the 50 result samples, a pinned roster commit precedes scheduled start by at least ten minutes, and observed B, places 1–3 and exacta payout match the separately published results table.
B is identified from the S/B column and is not inferred from finishing order or the winning technique.
The exacta payout is per 100 yen. No sales-close odds are implied.
